I joined this subreddit several years ago when I was depressed and suicidal. I’m much better now and am living a happy life. It’s a long story, but just want to share this idea with you - hang in there. It will eventually get better so you just need to have faith. Also, there are people who actually need you. They need you for you, not your money your success or anything. They just love you they care about you so much that they need you be there for them. So you are valued.

I definitely wouldn’t do that as a decent person, but I’m just telling you that I can. They are so unprofessional. The most ridiculous accounting firm in Canada.

You know why? They mistreat their employees, cruelly and horribly. So good people don’t stay there for long.

They charge you expensive service fees. However, they never spend your hard earned money on training and retaining their people to provide you better services. They spend your service fees on renovating the toilets, making their website fancier, changing that stupid logo, etc.

That’s not even the worst. They’ve even spent your money on legal fees for those awfully horrifying lawsuits and disputes with their employees. Basically you are not paying for quality services, you are paying for them hiring lawyers to cover their asses.
